dedupe_keys.name: networks qgis plugin for multimodal routing and accessibility

description: Networks is a QGIS plugin designed as a processing algorithm provider to manage linear networks and compute multimodal routing and accessibility. The plugin page lists generating a graph from a linear layer, inverting and splitting polylines, connecting points to linear objects, linear-based deterministic interpolation for accessibility maps and generating isochrone polygons. Coverage: any network layer loaded in QGIS. Format and access: installable from the QGIS plugin repository, with source code on GitHub. Licence and cost: GPL-3.0 (licence file in the repository), free. Caveats: the plugin page does not name the authors or the routing engine; the lead linked it to Cerema and the Musliw engine, which the pages read do not confirm. It supports network flow and accessibility studies of multimodal transport. It relates to QGIS and the ArcGIS public transit tools in the catalogue.
